Hi Elena — thanks for sending these over and for the clear note. I received the W-8BEN-E and Certificate of Incorporation. A few quick items from procurement/tax: 

- We need either a notarized W-8BEN-E or a notarized copy accompanied by an apostille/consular legalization to validate the treaty claim for a foreign entity. Plain scanned signatures without notarization are not sufficient for us to apply a 0% withholding.
- Please confirm the foreign TIN (RUT) on the Certificate of Incorporation or provide a separate official document showing the TIN. The tax team needs that to reconcile against the treaty claim.
- Ensure the legal entity name on the PO matches exactly the name on the incorporation document. If there are any DBA names, include a cross-reference.

Procurement will keep PO-0004789 in a temporary hold state until tax validates the supporting docs. Monica, Marcus — looping you in for next steps on activation once we have notarized/apostilled evidence.

If Elena can provide a scanned notarized copy plus apostille by EOD tomorrow, we can likely clear the PO on Thursday.

Elena — thanks for the quick turnaround. For clarity and to avoid back-and-forth, here is the procurement checklist we will use to release PO-0004789 from hold: 

1) Notarized W-8BEN-E (clear signature page) PLUS apostille or consular legalization (scanned PDFs accepted). Original couriered hardcopy is NOT mandatory unless our tax team requests it after review.
2) Official foreign TIN certificate (SII RUT confirmation) or equivalent government-issued tax ID document showing the RUT 76.123.456-7.
3) Certificate of Incorporation showing the exact legal name (AquaTerra Labs SpA) matching the PO.
4) If claiming treaty residence, a Certificate of Tax Residency from the Chilean tax authority (SII) dated within the last 2 years.

Once the three items above are uploaded to the Drive link (please use the folder referenced in the PO email) and we confirm name/TIN parity, procurement will: 
- Remove the PO hold and change status to "Active (pending invoice)."
- Notify Accounting to accept the first milestone invoice per the PO terms.

If anything is missing or the tax team needs a follow-up substantiation (e.g., translator-certified English copies), we will flag it within 24 hours. If you prefer, we can do a short call to walk through the documents — happy to schedule.
